note: Results of web checks made on 2026-10-06 by the independent verifier with web tools (recorded here as data; not re-runnable offline). The container's proxy blocked bigg.ucsd.edu, api.crossref.org and api.github.com for curl/gh; WebFetch was used for BiGG and Crossref, and raw.githubusercontent.com was reachable with curl.

bigg_models_list.verdict: Of the 16 study organisms only P. putida KT2440 and M. tuberculosis H37Rv have models in BiGG

curated_models_outside_bigg_for_study_or.also_listed_in_repo: data/fitness_browser/PROVENANCE.md lists Btheta 'with a curated model (iAH991)', MR1 'curated model iSO783', Smeli 'curated model iGD1575'

iML1515_source.repo_readme: This repository contains the code and data used for the analysis of the E. coli genome-scale metabolic model prediction accuracy using high-throughput mutant fitness data for gene knockouts across carbon sources.

iJN1463_source.why_not: bigg.ucsd.edu blocked for downloads from the container; WebFetch cannot hash a file
